info.name: CloudRcade login handoff
info.summary: Reuse a Nextcloud or Authentik session for trusted clients
info.description: Routes RetroArcade and Slate WASM Login Flow v2 requests through the existing SAML provider when a Nextcloud session is not already present. Trusted origins complete authorization through Nextcloud’s native login flow and password-confirmation safeguards, returning to fixed application callbacks.
info.author: CloudRcade contributors
